Aspect Ratio

Maintain a consistent width-to-height ratio for responsive images, videos, iframes, and other media content.

Basic Aspect Ratio

Use .zak-aspect-ratio to maintain a 16:9 ratio by default.

16:9 (default)
HTML
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio">
  <img src="image.jpg" alt="Description">
</div>

Ratio Variants

Choose from common aspect ratios for different content types.

.zak-aspect-ratio-1x1

1:1

.zak-aspect-ratio-4x3

4:3

.zak-aspect-ratio-16x9

16:9

.zak-aspect-ratio-21x9

21:9
HTML
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio-1x1">1:1 Square</div>
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio-4x3">4:3 Standard</div>
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio-16x9">16:9 Widescreen</div>
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio-21x9">21:9 Ultra-wide</div>

Responsive Aspect Ratio

Change aspect ratio at different breakpoints for adaptive layouts.

Responsive: 4:9 → 1:1 → 4:3 → 16:9
HTML
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio-4x9 zak-aspect-ratio-sm-1x1 zak-aspect-ratio-md-4x3 zak-aspect-ratio-lg-16x9">
  Responsive aspect ratio
</div>

Images

Wrap images in an aspect ratio container to prevent layout shift while loading.

Image placeholder
HTML
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio-16x9">
  <img src="photo.jpg" alt="Description" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">
</div>

Videos and Iframes

Embed responsive video players and iframes without aspect ratio distortion.

HTML
<div class="zak-aspect-ratio-16x9">
  <iframe src="https://..." title="Video" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>

CSS Reference

HTML
.zak-aspect-ratio {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  width: 100%;
}

.zak-aspect-ratio > * {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.zak-aspect-ratio-1x1 { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.zak-aspect-ratio-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.zak-aspect-ratio-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.zak-aspect-ratio-21x9 { aspect-ratio: 21 / 9; }

Accessibility

  • Always provide alt text for images inside aspect ratio containers
  • For iframes, include a descriptive title attribute
  • Videos should have captions or transcripts when possible
  • The aspect-ratio CSS property is well-supported; no fallback needed for modern browsers
